relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of TRPV1 on these afferents promotes the release of neuropeptides such as substance P (SP) and calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP)

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of HMGB1, a proinflammatory molecule that activates TRPV1, reduces cytokine-induced β-cell injury [32].

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 activation by capsaicin upregulates HDAC2 in the hippocampus, impairing neuronal maturation, synaptic protein expression, and inducing depression-like behavior [8].

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: acute TRPV1 activation promotes a transient Ca2+ influx that enhances GSIS via exocytosis.

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: chronic or repeated TRPV1 activation produces sustained Ca2+ elevation that overwhelms buffering systems and triggers ER stress [19].

key_findings: Review: TRPV1 has dual effects in beta-cells (acute enhancement of insulin secretion, chronic ER stress and apoptosis) and drives vascular, renal, CNS and neuropathic complications of T1D.
TRPV1+ sensory afferents release CGRP and substance P that shape islet inflammation.
